description: This file defines FastAPI route handlers related to user authentication, including registration, login, logout, and fetching current user info. It interacts with authentication services, manages JWT cookies, and specifies API endpoint metadata.

classes.name: AuthResponse
classes.description: Response schema for authentication endpoints, containing user details.

classes.name: LoginRequest
classes.description: Request schema for login with email and password.

classes.name: RegisterRequest
classes.description: Request schema for user registration with email and password.

classes.name: UserOut
classes.description: User schema used for outputting user information.

methods.name: AuthResponse register(payload: RegisterRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Handles user registration, creates new user via AuthService, and returns the user info.

methods.name: AuthResponse login(payload: LoginRequest, response: Response, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Authenticates user credentials, sets JWT cookie, and returns user info.

methods.name: dict logout(response: Response)
methods.description: Clears the JWT cookie to log the user out.

methods.name: UserOut me(request: Request, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Returns the currently authenticated user's information.

ctags.signature: (payload: LoginRequest, response: Response, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
